reviewer: implementation worker — code-grounded canonical probe and route-complete browser evidence; independent visual review remains the parent review gate
summary: Canonical Turkish BERT NER runs through raw ORT-Web with its exact cased tokenizer. The full route ladder and two-model language gate passed 73/73 automated browser assertions across 20 route/device/theme cells. Redaction is explicitly review-first, never a security guarantee.

rubric.evidence: Raw browser preflight retained at /tmp/turkish-ner-probe/result.json: canonical model.onnx SHA-256 a8f8a685… (440394743 bytes), ORT-Web WASM session, four discriminating Turkish inputs. Route acceptance models/bert-base-turkish-cased-ner/acceptance-run.json records 73/73 checks and real outputs on all five routes.
rubric.notes: No multilingual NER substitute is used. Multi-model adds language identification but the entity stage remains the canonical akdeniz27 model.

rubric.evidence: Browser logits are [1, WordPieces, 7]. 'Elif Şafak, Boğaziçi Üniversitesi'nde Ahmet Hamdi Tanpınar…' produced PER Elif Şafak 99%, ORG Boğaziçi Üniversitesi 100%, PER Ahmet Hamdi Tanpınar 100%; Tan + ##pınar is exposed raw then aligned to one word/span.
rubric.notes: The exact original-character offsets drive highlighting, JSON export, redaction and story recasting.

rubric.evidence: UI and worker pin akdeniz27/bert-base-turkish-cased-ner revision 99995f7d2be4b3a28c74f0d36ee97f8c04ee0571, root fp32 model.onnx 440394743 bytes, MIT, raw ORT-Web 1.22.0 WASM and Transformers.js 3.7.5 AutoTokenizer. At-a-glance states all of these plus the 420 MiB cost.
rubric.notes: The canonical repo has no Transformers.js onnx/model_*.onnx layout, so the raw ORT path is deliberate and inspectable.

rubric.evidence: Every route uses createModelLoader. Acceptance begins at download-required, streams the explicit 420 MiB download, writes one immutable URL to transformers-cache with fetch(cache:no-store), then proves cached auto-init on 19 later cells. Release → controls disabled → cached reload → ready is captured in the overview desktop-light lifecycle.
rubric.notes: Clear cached model and release controls are shared-loader controls; no service-worker duplicate is introduced.

rubric.evidence: acceptance-run.json retains checking/download-required/downloading/ready and release/reinitialise lifecycle snapshots. Worker and page exceptions surface in role=status aria-live regions; shared retry is present on load failure. Every supported cell reached ready with zero console/network failures.
rubric.notes: The page warns about storage and roughly 1–1.5 GiB transient memory before download.

rubric.evidence: Structured controls arrays are retained per acceptance cell. Real controls driven: edited textarea, examples, entity index, PER/ORG/LOC redaction toggles, recast fields/rebuild, Turkish/English/code-switch language samples, two-model run, release and cached reinitialisation.
rubric.notes: All visible controls are native elements with names; controls disable when their worker is released.

rubric.evidence: No entity arrays are embedded in UI source. The validator changes input and observes discriminating live spans: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk/Ankara/Türkiye Cumhuriyeti; Elif Şafak/Boğaziçi Üniversitesi/Ahmet Hamdi Tanpınar; practical spans and code-switched language routing.

All 20 cells report zero unnamed buttons and zero sub-44px interactive controls after applying min-block-size to native controls/details. Status/output regions are live, entities include visible text labels rather than colour alone, Turkish text regions carry lang=tr, and focus remains native/visible.
rubric.notes: Screenshots were generated for independent review at reports/acceptance/bert-base-turkish-cased-ner/.

rubric.evidence: 20/20 route/device/theme cells (1280×800 desktop and 360×740 DPR3 mobile, light+dark) report horizontal overflow 0, no clipped/small controls, zero console/network failures. Exact screenshots and structured hygiene are retained by the acceptance run.
rubric.notes: Responsive UX is supported on mobile, while the page honestly says whether a particular phone can afford the 420 MiB download/runtime memory is device-dependent.

rubric.evidence: All tokenizer, model-session, inference, WordPiece alignment and BIO aggregation work runs in module workers. PerformanceObserver evidence in every acceptance cell records zero main-thread long tasks during driven inference; typing is debounced 350 ms.
rubric.notes: ORT session creation is heavy but off-main-thread; WASM is single-threaded for broad hosting compatibility.

guidanceConsulted.query: real on-device NER streaming download and inference without INP regressions
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Move work over 250 ms to a Web Worker and keep UI updates separate from heavy computation.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: model download/read, ORT session creation, inference and post-processing all run in module workers; only compact DOM rendering stays on the main thread.

guidanceConsulted.query: large model loading progress caching and responsive browser behavior
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Avoid invisible blocking work, expose progress, cache deliberately and do not surprise constrained mobile devices.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: explicit 420 MiB Download, byte progress, immutable Cache Storage URL, release/clear controls, and prominent mobile/storage/transient-memory warning.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: overview at-a-glance plus acceptance cold lifecycle download-required→downloading→ready

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive entity control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use fluid wrapping layouts, logical sizes and intrinsic constraints instead of fixed viewport widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied through flex-wrap, auto-fit grids, min()/logical properties and wrapping token/entity surfaces.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: acceptance overflow=0 on all five routes at 360px and 1280px

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible native textarea checkbox select details and action controls
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer labelled native controls, visible focus, accessible status, and touch-sized targets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: labelled native controls, lang=tr inputs/outputs, role=status/aria-live, and 44px minimum button/input/summary height.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: acceptance unnamedButtons=0 and smallControls=[] in all 20 cells

guidanceConsulted.query: semantic HTML status output details tables and language metadata
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic landmarks/controls and language annotations so structure and pronunciation survive without custom widgets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: sections/headings, native table/details/summary, status live regions and lang=tr on Turkish text.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: all five route sources and structured DOM controls evidence

openQuestions: Would an upstream faithful q8 export preserve enough NER quality to reduce the 420 MiB download substantially? It must be independently compared before replacing this canonical fp32 lineage.
How should real low-memory phones expose a pre-download storage/RAM capability estimate when browsers do not provide reliable available-RAM information?

followUpGoals.goal: If the canonical publisher releases a quantised ONNX, add an evidence-backed dtype choice only after span-level parity testing; do not silently replace fp32.
